closure_claim: Every contributed abp adjustment amount within the bounded Schedule B interest-adjustment surface is recorded as a logical adjustment instance for 2025. This claim covers a taxable amortizable bond premium adjustment reported for one logical Schedule B interest-adjustment instance where the payer did not already net the amount only; it says nothing about other adjustment classes, total interest, investment calculations, tax-exempt interest, frozen deposits, savings bonds, transactions, or Schedule D.
title: Synthetic ABP Adjustment adjustment instances, tax year 2025
